secrets.name: LOVABLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Lovable AI Gateway API key for the /api/chat route (chat assistant). Get it from your Lovable project settings → Integrations / AI.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role (secret) key for the server-side admin client used by the regenerate-category-summary webhook. Get it from your Supabase project → Settings → API → service_role key.
